rules.statement: Non-compliance with Section 18 of the Prevention of Frauds Ordinance does not prevent the creation of a partnership, but merely prevents evidence of the partnership being adduced in certain circumstances.
rules.supporting_quote: "All that it does is to prevent evidence of the partnership being adduced in certain circumstances. It was, accordingly, competent to the defendant in the present case to show that the business between himself and the plaintiff did not constitute a co-ownership but is a partnership."
